land-110m.json and land-50m.json: the "land" layer of Natural Earth (naturalearthdata.com) at 1:110m and 1:50m, as packaged
as TopoJSON by world-atlas 2.0.2 (https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas, ISC licence for the packaging).
Natural Earth is in the public domain; no permission is needed and none is asked for, but it is credited on the map.
Used only by the "Night dots" basemap (public/js/night-dots.js), fetched only when that basemap is chosen.
